summary: Implemented the shared identity, organization, directory, group, role, and business-category contract; additive OSS D1 and Local SQLite persistence; email OTP, session, OIDC JIT, privacy-aware administration APIs; Console and CLI management; and Enterprise PostgreSQL/RLS, Node API, SMTP, SCIM, Helm, and operations support without deploying or publishing artifacts.

evidence.ref: pnpm test and Console Playwright identity administration E2E
Enterprise typecheck, test, build, Helm lint, migration, forced-RLS hostile probe, and non-superuser PostgreSQL integration

residual_risks: Production D1/PostgreSQL migration and Cloudflare or Kubernetes deployment remain intentionally operator-controlled.
Real SMTP delivery, external OIDC discovery, and Okta SCIM require environment-specific rollout verification.
